scenes.text: The probe had been silent for nineteen years.
scenes.art_prompt: a lone deep-space probe drifting in black void, faint Earth far behind, tiny blue marble, cinematic wide shot

scenes.text: Then, at 3:14 in the morning, it answered.
scenes.art_prompt: a cold mission control room at night, single glowing monitor, empty chairs, blue screen light

scenes.text: One word. Repeating. From a place no one had mapped.
scenes.art_prompt: an empty star map with unmapped coordinates, holographic grid over darkness, ominous
a radio telescope dish under a starry night sky, faint signal waves, eerie glow

scenes.text:
The probe was launched from Earth.
It had never been anywhere else.
scenes.art_prompt: an old launch facility on Earth, rocket on the pad at dawn, nostalgic, wide establishing shot

scenes.text: Follow Deep Space Logs for the next entry.
scenes.art_prompt: a silent deep-space probe silhouette against a vast nebula, stars, quiet and final
